support_agent.label: Support
support_agent.description: Stable support and internal-agent prompts with repeated user intents.
support_agent.evidence_basis: V7 support tape plants exact repeats and requires >=90% capture on duplicate cost.

batchable_jobs.label: Batchable
batchable_jobs.description: Non-urgent jobs that can use provider batch discounts or scheduled execution.
batchable_jobs.evidence_basis: Batch savings are direct arithmetic against provider batch pricing where catalog coverage exists.

agentic_research.label: Agentic research
agentic_research.description: Multi-step agent traces where repeated or wasted tool-planning calls can be detected.
agentic_research.evidence_basis: V7 agent-loop tape plants 16 redundant calls in 64 and requires quantified detection.

long_context.label: Long context
long_context.description: Large prompts, long histories, and repeated instructions where input tokens can be reduced.
long_context.evidence_basis: Compression/trim savings must be holdback or replay measured and net of compression overhead.

classification_routing.label: Routing-safe tasks
classification_routing.description: Low-risk classification, extraction, and routing tasks eligible for cheaper models.
classification_routing.evidence_basis: Routing/downshift claims require eval gates plus holdback or replay measurement.

general_chat.label: General chat
general_chat.description: High-variance interactive chat where the honest result is usually no optimization.
general_chat.evidence_basis: V7 high-variance tape requires no cache hits, no invented loops, and no painted savings.

claim_boundary.publishable_metric: P25-P75 true net savings rate after holdback, architecture overhead, and fee.
must_not_claim: A single flat savings rate for all customers.
Billable estimates before direct, holdback, or replay measurement exists.
required_refresh_before_public_update: Refresh SDK wrapper and sidecar latency/compute calibration from load_benchmark or production telemetry.
Regenerate this report and commit the JSON/proof pack together.
